chrome.mediaMissing: Audio unavailable: {name}. Select the original file to relink it.
chrome.replaceProjectBody: Unsaved project changes will be replaced.
chrome.hintDropOrOpen: Drop a WAV/OGG anywhere, or press Open.
chrome.emptySub: Drop a WAV / OGG here or press Open
chrome.calibrationHintBody: BPM (no beat limit). Tap "Enter", "," or "." on every click — the median updates live. Press "Finish" when it is stable; Apply subtracts it from Enter / , / . break points during playback.
chrome.tapsLive: Taps {matched}/{total} matched · median {median} ms · mean {mean} ms · ±{spread} ms
chrome.tapsFinal: Final: {matched}/{total} taps · median {median} ms · mean {mean} ms · ±{spread} ms
chrome.noTapsMatched: No taps matched ({total} tap(s) recorded) — restart and tap on the clicks.
chrome.titleBands: Band overlay: Low / Mid / High envelopes (display only)
chrome.titleRate: Monitor playback rate ([ slow down / ] speed up); markers and exports stay at source time
chrome.titleCalibrate: Tap calibration: 16 quarter-note clicks at the current BPM; press Enter on each beat to measure your latency
chrome.titleRms: RMS band (mean level inside the peaks)
chrome.closeConfirmBody: The opened file and all unsaved markers will be cleared, and the session archive is deleted.
chrome.discardRecoveryBody: This recovery archive cannot be restored. Opening other content will overwrite it. Discard it and continue?
chrome.relinkDifferenceBody: The selected audio "{selected}" does not match the project media "{current}". Adopting it updates the project media as one editable change.
chrome.legacyImportBody: The legacy recovery "{name}" holds {markers} cuts at BPM {bpm} (shift {shift}). Importing replaces the current workspace content.

menu.aboutDetail:
Electron + TypeScript reimplementation of woslicerIII.
Slice DSP and .wos format are byte-compatible with the original.

scopeRange: Scope: selection M{m0}–M{m1} ({seconds}s) · only this range
